# RUN APPAREL — 100% B2B Sustainable Sportswear Manufacturing

> RUN APPAREL (PVT) LTD is an ethical OEM/ODM sportswear and activewear manufacturer located in Sialkot, Pakistan.

## Overview

RUN APPAREL (PVT) LTD specializes in high-performance digital apparel manufacturing, sustainable material engineering, and agile white-label production for international sportswear brands, fitness clubs, and athletic teams.

## Core Pillars

- Sustainable Materials: GRS-certified recycled polyester, GOTS-certified organic cotton, and closed-loop bio-based fibers.
- Precision Automated Manufacturing: CAD pattern engineering, automated laser cutting, flatlock and seamless stitching.
- Low Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ): Flexible production starting at 50 pieces per style.
- Rapid Sampling: 7-day turnaround for physical prototypes and digital 3D tech packs.

## Public Endpoints and Catalog Sections

- [Product Catalog](https://wear-run.com/products): Comprehensive B2B sportswear collection covering activewear, compression gear, and technical performance outerwear.
- [Manufacturing Infrastructure](https://wear-run.com/manufacturing): Sialkot production facility overview, automated cut-and-sew lines, sublimation printing, and quality control lab.
- [Sustainability and LCA](https://wear-run.com/sustainability): Zero-landfill initiatives, closed-loop water treatment, and verifiable environmental impact metrics.
- [Technology and Innovation](https://wear-run.com/technology): 3D digital sampling, interactive tech pack visualization, and fabric performance benchmarks.
- [Inquiry and RFQ](https://wear-run.com/contact): Direct quotation requests, custom specifications submission, and sample development ordering.

## Technical Specifications and Credentials

- Headquarters and Facility: Sialkot, Punjab, Pakistan (Latitude 32.4945, Longitude 74.5229).
- Certifications: Global Recycled Standard (GRS), Global Organic Textile Standard (GOTS), OEKO-TEX Standard 100, ISO 9001:2015.
- Capabilities: OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer), ODM (Original Design Manufacturer), White-Label, Private Label.
- Production Lead Time: 7 days for physical prototypes; 3 to 4 weeks for bulk manufacturing orders.
